name: pl-small-company-financial-statements
description: Prepare and review Polish Accounting Act annual accounts for an ordinary standalone sp. z o.o. that qualifies as small but not micro and validly elects Annex 5. Covers the 2026 reporting framework, both profit and loss formats, balance sheet mapping, notes, measurement, depreciation, current and deferred tax, audit, management report relief, signatures, approval and KRS filing. Trigger on Polish small company accounts, załącznik 5, bilans, rachunek zysków i strat or sprawozdanie finansowe. Refuses regulated entities, groups, branches, MSR accounts and insolvency. This source cited draft requires professional review and does not establish filing readiness.
